name: Battle Planes Multiplayer
storyline:
Every kid in a Romanian, Russian or Chinese classroom knew the game: draw a 10x10 grid in the back of your notebook, hide three planes, and take turns calling out shots while the teacher wasn't looking. "B2!" Hit. "A10!" Miss. Hit a plane's head and it goes down in flames.

Battle Planes brings that classroom game back, drawn in pen on graph paper with doodled planes and a desk full of pencils. Hide your 3 planes, hunt your opponent's, and use every hit, miss and kill to work out where their heads are hiding. First to shoot down all 3 wins.

Play against the computer on Easy, Medium or Hard, pass a note to a friend with a private room code, or find a deskmate online and climb the Elo ranks.
summary: Battle Planes Multiplayer is the online version of Avioane (炸飞机), the pencil-and-paper game played in school notebooks for generations. Each player hides 3 planes on a grid, then you take turns calling shots: hit, miss or kill. Hit a plane's head and it goes down, and the first to take down all 3 planes wins. Play single-player against the AI or challenge friends online in quick turn-based 1v1 matches, free in the browser and on Android, coming to Steam.
